description_1line: Advanced-recycling operator: owns and operates pyrolysis plants converting end-of-life waste plastic into pyrolysis oil feedstock for new plastics
sources: https://freepointecosystems.com; https://www.woodgroup.com/news/latest-press-releases/2024/wood-to-operate-and-maintain-one-of-the-worlds-largest-plastics-recycling-facilities; Wood plc press release 2024 (operate/maintain Freepoint Hebron OH plant, ~90,000 t/yr end-of-life plastics to pyrolysis oil); Dow/Freepoint supply agreement (65,000 mt/yr certified-circular pyrolysis oil from Eloy AZ plant to Dow US Gulf Coast)
notes: Created 2026-10-30 in integration pass 17 from verification wave 1 verdict Freepoint Eco Systems (lane CF, tier B). ADJUDICATION: ACC Plastics Division IN screen was RIGHT, ISCC OUT screen was WRONG. OUT read the ISCC certificate product list (pyrolysis oil / pyrolysis gas / char) as 'charcoal/biochar only, no plastic feedstock' - those are the OUTPUTS; the deciding witness is the operator record: Freepoint 'owns and operates a state-of-the-art waste plastic upcycling facility in Hebron, Ohio' converting 180M lb/yr waste plastic into PyOil (its own release, via Waste360), corroborated by Wood (Hebron pyrolysis plant converting ~90,000 tons of end-of-life plastics into petrochemical feedstock) and the Dow offtake agreement for the Eloy AZ plant. Operator, not waste broker: it owns the plants and sells the pyrolysis oil. Ring 1 primary (on-site pyrolysis/depolymerisation of waste polymer at its own plant), Ring 3 secondary (recycling services).
